caseNameFull: Califano, Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare v, Westcott and Sharp, Commissioner, Department of Public Welfare of Massachusetts v. Westcott

opinions.text: Appeals from D. C. Mass. Motion of appellees for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted. Cases consolidated and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument. Reported below: 460 F. Supp. 737.
